## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Metz, France. It starts at 1,Parvis des Droits de l'Homme.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Feeling arty? Explore modern and contemporary art, ongoing cultural projects comprising temporary exhibitions, live performances, films, and talks in this unique space just over an hour by train from Paris!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.05. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 150 ratings and 67 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
